entry.name: rnbo_twist~
entry.description: The twist~ operator accepts a ramp between 0 and 1 (such as one generated by phasor~ ) and uses a lookup table to output a function using the same algorithm as the curve~ object. The curvature of the ramp is controlled by the curve inlet that ranges from -1 to 1. A curve value of 0 produces an output ramp identical to the input.

arguments.name: curve
arguments.description: Sets the parameters of the exponential function that generates the non-linear output. It can range between -1 and 1. For ascending ramps, values of curve less than 1 produce values above the linear input and values of curve greater than 1 produce values below the linear input. As curve values near -1 or 1, the curavture becomes more extreme.
